items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I thought at first it said Palmer maybe. Pomler. Pomler.

ctx.x: I thought at first it said Palmer maybe. Pomler. Pomler. Well, maybe we can get up there and see those fellows and talk to them too and interview them later. That's right.
